title: Gypsum Installers
experience: Previous professional experience in gypsum board installation is a must
description_text:
Our client is looking for an experienced and motivated Gypsum Installer to join their team in Malta.
 Key Responsibilities
 Install gypsum boards, partitions, ceilings, bulkheads, and other gypsum structures.
 Measure, cut, and fit gypsum boards according to project requirements.
 Prepare surfaces and ensure accurate and secure installation.
 Carry out jointing, filling, sanding, and finishing work to achieve a smooth result.
 Work from drawings, measurements, and instructions when required.
 Assist with general plastering and interior finishing works when needed.
 Maintain a clean and safe working environment.
 Ensure all work is completed to a high standard and within the required timeframe.
 Requirements
 Previous professional experience in gypsum board installation is a must .
 Experience with drywall, partitions, ceilings, or similar interior finishing works.
 Good knowledge of gypsum installation techniques and materials.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Good attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
 Reliable, motivated, and willing to work on different projects around Malta.
 What We Offer
 Full-time employment.
 Attractive salary based on experience and skills.
 Opportunity to work on a variety of residential and commercial projects.
 A professional and supportive working environment.
 Interested in this opportunity? Apply today and take the next step in your career.
